decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's announced direction of binding mobile communication and trusted second-channel interactions, so management stays committed to it despite only modest visibility.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture was elevated to its own page in 2019 and frames the firm's whole integrated offer, making it highly visible and central to its identity.

The QR-code hardware token got a dedicated page and rests on the firm's hardware investment and transaction-signing know-how, so weak sales would likely be blamed on temporary market conditions rather than end the product.

The payment compliance suite builds on established regulatory expertise, and recurring compliance demand supports continuing it, though its low visibility makes it the most likely candidate for quiet consolidation.
